verdict.rationale: The pack never documents a Square-hosted checkout page or payment link that a developer can redirect customers to. The Web Payments SDK (square-docs-31) is an embedded component for building your own payment UI. 'Prebuilt online payment solutions with top eCommerce providers' (square-docs-46) describes third-party platform integrations. The bare 'checkout' entry in the MCP service catalog lists a service name only and does not describe a hosted, conversion-optimized checkout experience.

support.subject: As a developer, I can redirect customers to a vendor-hosted, conversion-optimized checkout page without building my own payment UI
